content: Viyavǝtviig Yesu
Ghyǝnga ba Yesu dzǝgwazhigǝla, kaa dzǝva dlara Kidron kǝ iin ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrazahaan da tǝ kwah ghyaba. Gyilga dlariina ndza mǝng ɗyaghaara guuha, kaa daas kǝ iin ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrzahaan damma vakaiya.
Sǝrgasǝrǝg Yahud kwa vǝlǝt Yesu kwahiin kǝ vakavaka, aɗaba nǝtnǝg Yesu kǝ dzahav dǝ mbǝrzahaan vakwahiina.

Kaa sagau kǝ Yahud dǝ dakwala tlauja ard lii uufakyawa Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl kwa ɓǝlartǝrǝt mallaha zhiilakǝsuufah ard Farisiyaha, kaa dagal kǝ iitǝr damma ɗyaghaara guhiina, ar hakyahakya dǝ kaara jahuramba, ard zadah ard kadlanga ghwaava.
Sǝrgasǝrg tsau Yesu kǝ dǝgitahi da dzǝgaar dǝ iin baɗǝmma, kaa sagal kǝ iina, amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “War wam gatǝg nǝ uurami?”
Kaa ngwangug kǝ iitǝr, taakiya, “Yesu zhiila Nazaret.” Am Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Kai nǝ iina.” (Yahuda kwa vǝlǝt Yesu ndakwi ghacǝga ǝmǝtaɗ dǝ iitǝra.)
Tagatǝr ba Yesu taakiya, “Kai nǝ iina,” kaa hazha da tǝ hal kǝ iitǝra, ar mɓǝɗa da tǝ haaya.
Kaa gwiya ndavǝtǝrundavǝg Yesu, amaa, “Am gata wari?” Aiyam nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Yesu zhiila Nazareta.”
Kaa ngugangug kǝ Yesu amaa, “Ən naa ndza tagkurtag taakiya, ba kai nǝ iina. Akwamam gata ba kaiya, ɗuwamtǝrǝsɗug kǝ uudahaan dagala.”
Dzǝghaar kwakyarvad righǝvant nǝ ǝlbǝgi tagada Yesu taakiya, “Ma uudahaan vǝlǝghwa nǝnngna, maay wa zaazǝg aanji pall biya.”
Siman Bitrus kwa ndza dǝ katsakara, tǝɗadatǝɗǝg kǝ katsakar ghudarda kǝ hyimiya dǝvakaf kǝ kwatǝnaha maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufaha. Ɗaaga kwanǝn kǝ kwatǝnaha Malkus.
Am Yesu taa kǝ Bitrusa, “Gwidaagwig kǝ katsakaragh damma kumbǝghaana. Ən maay da hǝɓǝgaan ma kuwǝn kwa vǝlǝghwa Daad ǝn hǝɓu biya?”
Kaa vigǝtviig dakwala tlauja ard tlǝvukwatǝra, ard lii uufakyawa Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla Yahudah kǝ Yesu, ar nguɗǝnana.
Kaa lanngaan kǝ iitǝr ba zunngw da vak Hannana, dadda uusa Kayafa. Kayafa wa ndza maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufah ma kwahiin kǝ viiga.
Kayafa wa ɗiyatǝra sawari kǝ Yahudah taakiya, ngulǝm ǝmǝtsa nǝ uud pall dlakulva kyalǝma uudaha.
Ɓalaaɓalǝg Bitrus kǝ agajauwa sǝra Yesu

Kaa gata Yesu kǝ Siman Bitrus ard kwatlǝrǝn kǝ mbǝrz tǝ halaa. Kwanǝn kǝ mbǝrza, sǝrǝgasǝrǝg maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufahǝn kǝ iina, kaa daas kǝ iin damma huɗa gaagazaiya vǝgya maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufahǝn ǝmǝtaɗ dǝ Yesu.

Kaa ghacǝgaghacǝg kǝ Bitrus tǝ ghaiya wakyagha. Kaa gwiya sagal kǝ mbǝrzǝn kwa sǝrǝgasǝrǝg maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufahǝn da taa ghai dǝ dǝghwa hǝnyaha zhiilakǝsuufǝn tǝ ghaiya wakyagha, tǝhala kwaha, sǝdaa kǝ Bitrusa.
Aiyam nǝ dǝghwǝn uufa wakyaghǝn kǝ Bitrusa, “Agha maay kwan nǝnng pall ma mbǝrzaha uudanǝn biya?” Ngwangug nǝ Bitrus amaa, “Ən maay ma iitǝr biya.”
Ndza akuhy vakka, kaa mbiigantmbiig kǝ kwatǝnahah ard lii uufakyawa kǝ kaara ghuvǝr ar ghacaraan ar cinnga hurfakaana, Bitrus ndakwi ndza ghacǝgan ǝmtaɗ dǝ iitǝra.
Ndavǝgharundavǝg maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufah kǝ Yesu kǝ ndavǝgaha
Kaa ndavǝgarundavǝg maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufah kǝ Yesu tǝghǝr kǝ mbǝrzahaana ard tsagaanana.

Kaa ngughwarangug Yesu taakiya, “Tagandatag kǝ ǝlbǝg ba tǝ ɓalaɓal tǝvukwa uudah baɗǝmma, dlaɓa tlakwatlǝg tsagaan ma guda dzahavaha ard Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, vakavaki dzahavǝt Yahudah baɗǝmma. Tappana bi kǝ taa dǝgiti shǝɓashǝɓan biya.
Iyau, agha ndavǝgwa da ɓaw kaci kǝ ndavǝgahi? Ba agha ndavtǝru kǝ lii cinngaracinng kǝ dǝgiti tagantǝr nai kǝ ndavgahaana, aɗaba ar sǝrgasǝrǝg kǝ dǝgiti taganda naiya.”
Tagada ba Yesu kǝ kwaha, kaa tsǝgaan kǝ pall ma lii uufakyau kwa ghacǝganǝn dǝ mahupeng kǝ Yesu, amaa, “Agha ngugugar ndkwan kǝ maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufaha?”
Kaa ngwangug kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Akwama mǝng dǝgiti kwa naa tagǝda nai ghwaɗa, marwadamarǝg kǝ ghwaɗǝraana. Akwama ba jiir nǝ dǝgiti naa tagda naiya, aujilbǝg kaci agha tsa kaiyi?”
Kaa ɓǝlgantɓǝlǝg Hannana kǝ uudah dagal dǝ Yesu nguɗanguɗan da vak Kayaf maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufaha.
Gwiya ɓalaaɓalǝg Bitrus kǝ agajauwa sǝra Yesu

Gwastaan ba ndzǝganaan Bitrus ba ghacǝga vakwah tǝghǝr kǝ kaara cinnga hurǝfaka. Kaa ndavǝgarundavǝg kǝ kyalmah taakiya, “Aayaa, agha maay nǝnng kwan pall ma mbǝrzahaan biya?” Kaa ɓala gajau kǝ Bitrus amaa, “Ən maay ma iiter biya.”
Am pall ma kwatǝnaha maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufaha. Yiiga kwa ghudǝgharda Bitrus kǝ hyimi na, amaa taa kǝ Bitrusa, “Mbats nǝghankak bi ǝmtaɗ dǝ iin ma guhiin kwan biya?”
Kaa gwiya ɓala gajau kǝ Bitrusa. Tǝhala kwaha, kaa wiig kǝ ghwatkala.
Yesu tǝvuukwa gumna Bilatusa

Kaa sǝdasǝg kǝ tlǝvuukwa Yahudah kǝ Yesu sagal ma vǝgya Kayafa da vǝgya gumǝna Roma. Ma sartǝn lanngar nǝ iitǝrna, cagaacag nǝ kǝsa. Kaa lǝwalǝg kǝ iitǝr daa damma huɗa gaagazaiya, hai kǝ ndzǝgana kwadlambǝr kǝ iitǝr tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl kwa da tsava iitǝr kǝ zaa kafa hwaɗaga haarakǝsa dzava hǝnnyaha.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, kaa sǝgalsǝg kǝ Bilatus saa vakaatǝr gyimala, amaa, “Hulfa kwar kǝ ɗiya ghunj wa maa sǝdǝv nǝ uuram tǝghǝr kǝ kwan kǝ uudi?”
Kaa ngugwangug kǝ iitǝr taakiya, “Akwama dadda haip bi nǝ iin biya, ma kǝmnda maay lanngaan saa vakagh biya.”

Am Bilatus taa kǝ iitǝra, “Lanngamlanng dagal ba dǝ ghǝraruwa, am ghudarda kǝ sharri kalkal dǝ adzahadzaharuwa.” Aiyam Yahudah taa kǝ iina, “Vǝlakǝmnd bi nǝ uud kǝ ndzǝɗa ghudǝgarda tsa shifǝg kǝ uud biya.”
Dzǝghaar kwakyarvad righǝvant nǝ ǝlbǝgi tagada Yesu tǝghǝr kǝ hulfa ǝmtsǝgi da ǝmtsǝg nǝ iina.)
Kaa gwiya daas kǝ Bilatus daa damma gaagazaiya tlǝkǝsa, tǝhala kwaha kaa ɗagantɗaag kǝ iin kǝ Yesu ndavaru amaa, “Kǝgh Tlǝkǝsa yaa Yahuda?”
Kaa ngugwarangug Yesu amaa, “Kwan kǝ ndavǝg aa sǝgal ma ghǝragh nii, uudahi tlǝrn ha wa tagakaktag kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝskaiyi?”
Kaa ngungangug Bilatus amaa, “Ən zhiila Yahudah naiya? Sarkadǝv zarabahagh Yahudah ard maal ba tingting ma zhiilakǝsuufah saa vakara. Au waghaa ɓaga nǝnngi?”

Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Tlǝkǝsǝrara dǝga kwan kǝ duni biya. Akwama dǝga kwan kǝ duni tlǝkǝsǝrara, maraa ɓagaan kwatǝnahar kǝ ghwaav maa hai kǝ vikwaviig kǝ Yahudaha. Amma tlǝkǝsǝrar vakavaki tlǝrna.”

Aiyam Bilatus taa kǝ iina, “Kats agha tlǝkǝsa?” Kaa ngugwarangug kǝ Yesu amaa, “Kǝgh dǝ ghǝragh waa tagda taakiya ǝn tlǝkǝsa. Yaakwi kwakyarvad kwan nǝ uuda, dlaɓa sanhi kwakyarvad kwan sa ma duniya, aɗaba ǝn ɓaga kǝ shiida jiijiira. Dlaɓa baɗǝm daddakwa dǝga jiira, cinngaan kǝ ǝlbǝgara.”
Kaa ndavǝgarundavǝg kǝ Bilatus amaa, “Au jiiri?” Ndavǝgharu ba nǝ iin kwan kǝ ndavǝga, kaa gwiya sagal kǝ iin sa vak Yahudaha amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Viyanǝt bi nai dǝ haip biya.
Amma mǝnng nǝ dǝga daadijaharuwa, akwama ɓagaaɓag sarta hwaɗaga haarakǝsa dzǝva hǝnnyaha, ǝn ɓǝlkursɓǝlg kǝ uud pall ma guda bǝrfǝnga. Am naagaan ǝn ɓǝlkurnǝs kǝ tlǝkǝsa Yahudaha?”
Kaa gwiya ngugǝg kǝ iitǝra, ar ɗiyaru kǝ cauw ar taakiya, “Maaya kwan biya, Barabbas wa kǝm naag nǝmnda.” (Barabbas ndza dadda zaaɗuula.)
